messages.author: 782ed6ec348dba9b
messages.subject: New App posted - Wikipedia Search Rates
parts:
Hi
  New one up can be accessed either via

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/pssguy/wikiSearchRates/ 
or shiny::runGist('4171750')

I'm a bit embarrassed sharing the code but there is one oddity from developing
on my own computer cf the remote version which I would particularly appreciate comment on
When I run it from desktop  RStudio there is no need for the string manipulation of lines
11 and 32,33. However when these are absent from the web version then errors occur e.g I get rates for 'Justin'
not 'Justin Bieber'
 I'd appreciate anyone pointing out theerror as I would rather revert to desktop version

cheers

Very Cool!

Since this was an election year, this graph was interesting:

"Barack Obama, Mitt Romney" going back 4 months

Notice the spikes in searches for Romney's page vs. Obama's page on the date of the debates, but on election day Obama's searches look higher.

It would be really neat to link to a graph like this using HTTP GET variables placed at the end of the url, explained in this thread:
